items.text: – Dutsen marmal ne. Marmal yana nufin mai tsada sosai.
items.q: A boy is meant to mispronounce 'marble' and think it means expensive. Is 'marmal' a natural child's slip of 'marmar', still recognizable?
before: Mun ci gaba kuma. A tsakiyar hanya akwai gida. Bangon nata yana da kyau. Ghassem kullum yakan ce:
